items.quote: The abundant Bacteroides genus is particularly important for the production of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) from the breakdown of complex dietary carbohydrates
items.location: body: Introduction

items.quote: Among Firmicutes, Faecalibacterium, Roseburia, and Bifidobacterium also represent common, abundant genera potently contributing to gut health, immunoregulation, and metabolic functions

items.quote: several Bifidobacterium strains can upregulate tight junctions, β-catenin, claudin-3, occludin, and ZO-1, along with increased barrier-modifying mucin 2, IL-10, and PPARγ, while downregulating proinflammatory TNFα and IL-6

items.quote: goblet cells that produce mucin glycoproteins forming a protective mucus layer, which can partly be stimulated by Ruminococcus gnavus

items.quote: patients who receive broad-spectrum antibiotics with anaerobic coverage could be at increased risk for severe aGVHD, particularly when antibiotics are administered peri-transplant

items.quote: A mouse study utilizing cohousing and antibiotic treatments demonstrated that distinct bacteria, again selected through different types of antibiotics, could either promote or control GvHD through inducing or inhibiting class II MHC molecule expression on IECs, independently of donor–host genetic disparity

fields.mechanism_as_named: Lachnospiraceae at neutrophil recovery negatively correlated with aGVHD

items.note: Negative correlation with aGVHD read as protective; the preceding sentence gives Lachnospiraceae as an unspecified-direction predictor from a different cohort.

items.quote: They have been linked to a gut microbiota with high diversity early after allo-HSCT and with decreased GvHD incidence and increased OS
items.location: body: THE gut microbiota fine-tunes immune responses and regulation > Other immune cells
items.note: MAIT cells linked to microbiota diversity; diversity is not a target (codebook 1.1). [96]

items.quote: Tissue-resident invariant NKT cells are activated by self- or bacterial-derived (e.g. Bacteroides fragilis) lipids presented on CD1 molecules
items.location: body: THE gut microbiota fine-tunes immune responses and regulation > Other immune cells
items.note: B. fragilis named as a lipid source for iNKT activation, with no GVHD outcome in the statement (codebook 1.2). [97]

items.quote: an association of Lachnospiraceae- and Oscillospiraceae-associated bacteriophages with immune-modulatory metabolite production
items.location: body: Orchestration of the intricate crosstalk between gut microbiota and immune cells
items.note: Link runs taxon -> phage -> metabolite production, with no GVHD outcome in the statement (codebook 1.2). [100]

items.quote: a phage-derived antibacterial enzyme was shown to lyse the Enterococcus faecalis biofilm, a aGvHD risk factor, both in vitro and in vivo
items.location: body: Orchestration of the intricate crosstalk between gut microbiota and immune cells

fields.mechanism_as_named: E. faecalis biofilm is an aGvHD risk factor targeted by a phage enzyme

items.note: Enterococcus is on the 4.1 pathobiont list, so 4b. 'In vivo' names no species, so evidence stays unspecified; intervention is 'other' (phage-derived lytic enzyme).

items.quote: individual gut commensals (e.g. Blautia, Bacteroides fragilis, Faecalibacterium duncaniae) clearly drive immunoregulatory responses proficiently curbing detrimental inflammation in in vitro and preclinical studies
items.location: body: Future directions/opinion
items.note: Outcome is inflammation rather than a GVHD outcome (codebook 1.2); the three taxa carry aGvHD claims from Table 1.

items.quote: microbiota diversity was clearly demonstrated to protect against aGvHD
items.location: body: Future directions/opinion
items.note: Diversity-only statement; diversity is not a row (codebook 1.1).

items.quote: the ability of FMT products or bacterial strains such as F. duncaniae or Akkermansia muciniphila to overcome resistance to immune checkpoint blockade
items.location: body: Future directions/opinion
items.note: Outcome is antitumour response/checkpoint-blockade resistance, not GVHD (codebook 1.2). [65,102–104]

items.quote: High microbiota diversity and the presence of key commensals protect against aGvHD through priming, activating, and/or modulating immunoregulatory cell subsets, which in turn promote gut barrier integrity.
items.location: figure 1 caption
items.note: Figure 1 repeats taxa and directions already in the text and carries no citations, so it is skipped (codebook 2). Note that the figure places Enterobacteriaceae on the low-aGvHD side, which the text does not state.
